title: A Choir for the Oath
author: I. M. Iversen
blurb: Ivo Eastwick, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
